name: Solenne NeuralSkin Spire Climate Bodysuit
description: The NeuralSkin is the base layer that Spire augmentation demands — a full-body nano-fabric suit in translucent ivory that becomes nearly invisible against most skin tones. Gossamer-thin but structurally dense, it reads body temperature, ambient conditions, and chrome implant power draw simultaneously, adjusting thermal output zone by zone in real time. Where chrome meets skin, the NeuralSkin forms data-conductive contact patches that route power and signal between implants without external wiring. Geneware accommodations include seamless membrane splits for tails, dorsal ridges, and bioluminescent skin panels.
functionality: Active zone-by-zone climate regulation synced to BCI biofeedback; maintains optimal skin temperature regardless of external conditions. Routes power and data between chrome implants via contact patches, eliminating external cabling entirely. Self-repairs minor tears within 20 minutes. Compatible with full-body geneware including tails, wings, and bioluminescent skin.
what_it_says: Your body is an optimized system and you can afford to treat it like one.
story_hooks: The NeuralSkin's chrome interface patches passively log all implant activity — Solenne's data retention policy is buried in a 400-page terms document almost no one has read.
A black-market replica NeuralSkin is circulating in Tier 3 — it looks identical but the conductive patches have a subtle backdoor that can shock the wearer into unconsciousness on remote command.
A Spire executive's NeuralSkin began self-repairing around a foreign object — something small, metallic, and deliberately placed inside the substrate before delivery.

physical_description.visual_profile: A barely-there second skin that clings to the body like mist, appearing almost translucent against flesh. Under certain angles and lighting, faint iridescent shimmer betrays the nano-weave. On augmented individuals, it becomes nearly invisible—the garment disappears, leaving only the chrome and geneware visible. Sleek, anatomical, ethereal.
physical_description.fit: Compression-fit without restriction; follows every contour of the body like a second dermis. Stretches with movement, never bunching or riding. Designed for zero friction against chromed limbs and implant interfaces.
physical_description.primary_material: Solenne proprietary nano-fabric composite—gossamer-thin synthetic bio-responsive weave with conductive threading. Translucent ivory base with embedded nanothermal adjustment fibers.
physical_description.texture: Impossibly smooth to the touch, almost liquid-like. Up close, reveals a faint hexagonal nano-lattice pattern. Frictionless against skin and chrome both. Slightly cool to initial contact, then body-temperature within seconds.
physical_description.color_scheme: Translucent ivory with subtle iridescent undertones (pale blue, silver, ghost-white). Conductive contact patches at implant interface points appear as faint silvered veins running along limbs and spine. Bioluminescent membrane cutouts glow softly when powered.
physical_description.closures: None—full-body pull-on with stretch-fit elasticity. Membrane splits at neck, wrists, ankles, and along spine release via magnetic micro-clasps for removal. Geneware accommodations feature invisible seam-bonded openings.
distinctive_features: Data-conductive contact patches at implant interface points (neck, shoulders, lower spine, major joints)
Zone-responsive thermal adjustment—micro-channels visible under magnification
Seamless membrane splits for geneware accommodation (tail sockets, dorsal ridge ports, bioluminescent panel integration)
Solenne delta-logo embossed in metallic thread at left collarbone—visible only under specific light angles
Regenerative fiber structure—minor tears self-fuse over 6-12 hours
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury augmentation infrastructure. This is the undergirding of high-end neural and chrome integration—only accessible to those with Spire-level implant systems.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by elite augmented individuals—corpo neural-ops, high-tier military somatic contractors, wealthy transhumanist enthusiasts. Signals deep integration with cutting-edge biotechnology and financial access to Solenne's exclusive biosystems ecosystem.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly worn. The nano-fabric resists visible damage—no fraying, staining, or creasing. Well-maintained Spire users keep it immaculate; worn garments show faint power-cycle heat marks along conductive pathways.

image_prompt: High-fashion cyberpunk product shot of a translucent ivory NeuralSkin Spire bodysuit on an androgynous chrome-augmented model, shot against a dark matte backdrop. The model's chrome limbs and neural interface ports catch cool blue-white studio lighting, while the bodysuit becomes nearly invisible—only its iridescent shimmer and silvered conductive pathways visible where it clings to skin and interfaces with implants. Soft rim-lighting along the silhouette emphasizes its gossamer nature. Close-up detail panel showing the hexagonal nano-lattice weave and conductive contact patches. Moody, clinical, utterly luxe. --ar 2:3 --v 6
